description: Self-contained PgWire smoke passed 8/8, covering startup/auth, simple query, extended metadata, parameterized execution, COPY FROM STDIN CSV, and querying copied rows.
Java is installed, but pgbench is missing and BenchBase/LDBC/CH benchmark artifacts are not configured via their expected environment variables.
Extended RowDescription reports schema-level OIDs for id INT4, name TEXT, DATE, TIMESTAMP, NUMERIC, and INTERVAL; this is a prerequisite for JDBC-style benchmark adapters.
Move from raw PgWire smoke to JDBC/tool compatibility: PostgreSQL JDBC driver smoke, pg_catalog/information_schema probes, and external artifact bootstrap for BenchBase/LDBC/CH-benCHmark.
